outcome: need for re-admission within 30 days postpartum
rates of achieving active labor within 24 h
cohort: The study included 24,966 women with prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM) at term from a single university-affiliated tertiary medical center between 2011 and 2023.
finding: The need for re-amniotomy during delivery in women with PROM is independently associated with an increased risk for cesarean delivery and prolonged labor.
mod_finding: Re-amniotomy was associated with higher cesarean delivery rates (10.2% versus 5.6%) but no independent associations were found with assisted operative vaginal delivery after multivariate adjustment.
